cover.title: your client roster shouldn't live in your head

slides.title: Import each client once
slides.body: save their approved colors, logo, and fonts in a dedicated Poaster brand kit so the right identity is ready whenever you create

slides.title: Pick the saved kit
slides.body: when a client sends a new brief, select their saved kit instead of searching through folders or remembering which rules belong to whom

slides.title: Give Poaster the content
slides.body: paste a link or short prompt and let it build the graphic around that client's visual identity without starting from a blank canvas

slides.title: Keep every deliverable aligned
slides.body: the saved kit carries the right colors, logo, and fonts into each graphic so client work stays recognizable even when you're managing several accounts

slides.title: Scale the workload, not the team
slides.body: generate polished social graphics faster across your client roster and spend your time on strategy, approvals, and relationships instead of repetitive design work

slides.title: Turn the nightly backlog into a repeatable system
slides.body: Poaster helps freelancers and lean agencies move from one client brand to the next without hiring a designer just to keep production moving

end.title: One account, one saved identity, fewer production decisions
end.subtitle: With Poaster, import each client brand once and keep creating on-brand content as your roster grows
